source: Failure taxonomy for AI-generated 2D animation. Each rule names what automation can and cannot decide.

rules.history: A generated frame repeats a later pose and loses an intermediate phase (e.g. push-off).
rules.prevention: Compare each frame against frozen phase references with a registered descriptor, plus declared contact roles.
rules.automation: partial; similar phases alias, final call is visual

rules.history: Fractional timing adds or drops held ticks over repeated loops.
rules.prevention: Integer tick holds, locked in the contract; replay the actual schedule.

rules.history: Adding drawings or redistributing holds made an accepted cycle jerky.
rules.prevention: Freeze holds; change one gap at a time and re-check.
rules.automation: automatic for cadence; grace is visual

rules.history: Equal frame height hid width, limb-mass, or head-size changes.
rules.prevention: Silhouette area/width/height vs the reference cycle, never height alone.

rules.history: One frame's torso was elongated and another compressed while height and phase order stayed correct.
rules.prevention: Declared visible-feature span vs the standing master, plus adjacent-frame pulse limit.
rules.automation: automatic for declared features; occluded features stay unmeasured

rules.history: Costume or skin colours wandered between frames of one cycle.
rules.prevention: Quantised palette histogram vs the approved master per frame.
rules.automation: automatic for palette; texture quality is visual

rules.history: Tight bounds clipped heel, toe, or sole pixels.
rules.prevention: One native canvas for every frame; no per-pose fitting; margin checks.
rules.automation: partial; clipping automatic, plausible feet visual

rules.history: A planted phase floated: the sole left its contact window.
rules.prevention: Declared contact windows with minimum visible span per support phase.
rules.automation: partial; sliding within a held drawing needs motion review

rules.history: Hands or held props jumped between phases.
rules.prevention: Reviewed anchors per phase with a maximum distance. Anchors are declared, never inferred from colour.
rules.automation: partial; unmeasured anchors are warnings, never passes

rules.history: Editing an edit accumulated muddy texture and identity drift.
rules.prevention: Briefs always bind the original master plus an independent identity reference; a previous edit is never the sole reference; rejected paths are forbidden.

rules.history: Passing exports or frame counts were mistaken for acceptance.
rules.prevention: technical_status and visual_acceptance are separate fields in every report; approval is a recorded human decision.

rules.history: A local fix silently changed feet, hands, or contacts elsewhere in the frame.
rules.prevention: Repairs declare an allowed region and protected regions; batches are evaluated whole and must strictly improve.
rules.automation: automatic for pixels; expressive quality visual
